UN Experts Criticize Life Sentence for Baloch Activist in Pakistan

The United Nations has condemned the life sentence given to Dr. Mahrang Baloch, a political activist from the Balochistan region of Pakistan, who heads the Baloch Yakjehti Committee. The UN's criticism comes as tensions between Pakistan and the international community over human rights issues escalate. This development highlights the ongoing concerns about freedom of expression and the treatment of minority groups in Pakistan.
